title: Adding `IsVerifiedDomain` to the `AzureADTenant` module
summary: The Azure AD Tenant module now includes a method to check if a domain is verified in the tenant's list of verified domains, retrieved from Microsoft Graph.
key_points: New IsVerifiedDomain method added to validate domains against tenant's verified domain list
Uses Microsoft Graph /organization endpoint to retrieve verified domains
Supports skip review for trusted senders functionality
Returns empty list if LicensingService change is not deployed
Part of system-wide trusted sender handling
quote: Allows a consumer to validate whether a given domain is in the list of verified domains of a tenant
